title: The gate in its own process
command: umwayi/broker.py: started by the supervisor for an enforced Claude Code run; it has no command of its own
honesty: Built and tested with fakes. No real enforced goal run has finished yet (W40), so this is cooperative today and enforced where built.
analogy: A bank teller behind glass. The customer, the helper, can ask for anything, but only the teller can open the till, which is the logbook, and write the receipt.
analogy_stops: A teller is at the counter every day. The broker exists only for an enforced run, and no real goal has run that way to the end yet.
does_not: It does not start by itself: the supervisor starts one broker for each enforced run.
It does not confine the helper: confinement is a separate piece.
It never sends file content or rule text back, only a verdict word and a rule id.
owner_check: Read the words it answers with and see that nothing else comes back.
Check that no page says enforced for a real run before W40.

scenes.label: A helper asks
scenes.caption: The hook of the helper sends one short request to the broker over a private socket.

scenes.label: A run it does not know
scenes.caption: A request from a run that is not in the broker's own table is refused with the word unknown_run.

scenes.label: A rule says ask
scenes.caption: When the rules say Ask me first, the call is refused and one row goes to the owner's queue.

scenes.label: The switch is on
scenes.caption: With the kill switch on, every check is answered No, with the word kill_switch.

scenes.label: The log cannot be written
scenes.caption: If the logbook cannot be written, the answer is No, with the word log_failed.
